ValidationRule.description: CJ: Created for NZC Implementation PhII_UC008_US04 ESG/Data Modeller can only edit Footprint stage field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( $User.User_Type__c ,"ESG Team") || ISPICKVAL( $User.User_Type__c ,"Data Modeller"), ISCHANGED( Carbon_Footprint_Approver__c ) || ISCHANGED( Name ) || ISCHANGED(OwnerId) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: As ESG/ Data Modeller you can only update Carbon Footprint stage
